literal_meaning: শিকে (ঝুলন্ত সিঁড়ি বা লাঠির মতো কিছুতে) উঠা
figurative_meaning_en: To be suspended or put on hold
example_sentences_in_english: His studies have been put on hold.
The project is suspended due to lack of funds.
note: Idiom evokes imagery of something stuck midway, like climbing a ladder without progressing.
